events.details: Defunct. Only one archived ISP homepage exists (Sep 2007) and both candidate domains are now dead/sold, so the unsupported c. 2010 estimate is replaced by the last hard evidence of life in 2007; the operator's ABN is still active. only archived ISP homepage; .com.au domain later dropped. Dead as an ISP; the operator's sole-trader ABN ('GTBnet VOIP Services') was still active Mar 2026 — VoIP-only continuation does not extend the ISP record.

refs.label: Sep 2007: live Cairns retail ISP/VoIP site - the ONLY archived capture of gtbnet.com.au (domain now NXDOMAIN).
Operator's ABN remains active (record updated 31 Mar 2026) - the business may outlive the website; hence flagged still-active.
Refutes the brief's claim the business moved to gtbnet.com: that domain hosted a Japanese band (2009-13) and is a for-sale lander in 2022-2026.
